title: Computational-Biology-OceanOmics/OceanGenomes-refgenomes pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

teloseq.description: Telomere sequence motif to search for

primary_assembly.errorMessage: Primary assembly must be a valid directory path
primary_assembly.description: Optional path to directory containing a pre-computed single-haplotype assembly FASTA/GFA. Activates the single-haplotype subworkflow (skips Hifiasm and hap2). Auto-detects .fa/.fasta/.gfa files (optionally .gz compressed).

hap1_assembly.description: Optional path to a pre-computed hap1 assembly file or directory (FASTA/GFA, optionally .gz). Provide together with hap2_assembly to run the full dual-haplotype pipeline from an existing assembly, bypassing Hifiasm.

hap2_assembly.description: Optional path to a pre-computed hap2 assembly file or directory (FASTA/GFA, optionally .gz). Provide together with hap1_assembly to run the full dual-haplotype pipeline from an existing assembly, bypassing Hifiasm.
